<section class="band lodb" id="lod">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="head">
      <div><p class="kick">Level of Development</p><h2>From massing to <em>as-built.</em></h2></div>
      <p class="lead">LOD defines how much geometric detail and reliable information a model carries at each stage of a project. One building, our Royal Conservatory of Brussels model, from LOD 100 to LOD 500. Tap a level or swipe the model.</p>
    </div>
